recipes.name: Stir-fried kimchi (Kimchi-bokkeum: 김치볶음)
ingredients: 1 pound (453 grams) fermented sour kimchi, chopped
1 to 2 tablespoons gochujang (Korean hot pepper paste)
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add the kimchi and onion and stir it with a wooden spoon for about 1 minute.
Add sugar and gochujang. Keep stirring for about another 4 minutes until the kimchi softens and the onion looks translucent.
Remove from the heat and stir in the sesame oil.
Serve as a side dish for rice. Put the leftovers into an airtight container and refrigerator up to 1 week.
